# Wroxhall Creamery — cold store telemetry journal

One journal per store per day, merged from the sensor writers. Record
lines read:

    <timestamp> <severity> <writer> <message>

Severity tokens are INFO, WARN, ALARM and CLOSE; a door-open alarm is an
ALARM line whose message starts with "door-open".

Two writers feed the journal:

- portal-utc — the main telemetry portal. All its stamps are UTC
  (trailing Z).
- door3-gw — the door 3 sensor gateway, which predates the UTC migration
  and stamps Europe/London local time with a +01:00 summer offset. Its
  local stamps run one hour ahead of UTC.

The cold-store dashboard and every incident window are quoted in UTC, so
a window scan must place each line by the instant it describes, not by
the clock it was stamped with. The last line is a CLOSE record whose
records= count covers the record lines above it.
